contract_completeness: Every required field has an explicit JSON type, shape, defining equation or predicate, and canonicalization rule.

safety_certificate.canonicalization: must derive from least_fixpoint and public query

task_rules: An abstract state is null for bottom or a map from every variable to [lower,upper]. Bounds use integers in the finite range plus strings -inf,+inf; arithmetic outside the range rounds outward to infinity.

Round zero maps every node to bottom. Each next synchronous round injects initial_state at entry and joins every incoming edge image. Include the first repeated snapshot, which certifies a fixed point.
The submitted fixed point must also equal an independent chaotic-worklist result, include every final edge image, and imply the public safety query.
